Dahu Park HotelNeihu, Taipei City, Taiwan

    Book your stay at Dahu Park Hotel

    Lakeside rooms, a water park, and family suites your kids will never want to leave.(歡迎來到大湖公園飯店！)

    Swimming pool and water park(游泳池與水上樂園)

    Slides, a wave pool and a lazy river. Free for every hotel guest.(滑水道、造浪池與漂漂河，所有住客免費使用。)

    Booking takes about 3 minutes: room, dates, guests, extras, your details.(預訂約需3分鐘。)

    Choose your room(請選擇房型)

    Tap a photo to see the full picture, then press Select. Prices are per night.(點選照片可查看完整圖片，再按「Select」選擇房型。價格為每晚。)

    Pick your dates(選擇入住及退房日期)

    Check-in is from 3:00 PM. Check-out is by 12:00 PM.(入住時間為下午3:00起，退房時間為中午12:00前。)

    Length of stay(入住天數)1 night
    Room rate(房價)

    How many guests?(請選擇入住人數)

    Guests staying(入住總人數)
    1

    Add extras(選擇附加服務)

    All optional. You can skip this step.(皆為選填，可直接略過此步驟。)

    An extra bed is needed for your number of guests, so it stays selected.(您的人數超過房型上限，因此已自動選取加床。)

    Included with every stay(每次入住皆包含)

    Swimming pool and water park access, high-speed Wi-Fi, and free luggage storage.(游泳池及水上樂園、高速無線網路、免費行李寄放。)

    Guest details(填寫房客資料)

    We need the main guest's name to register the booking.(請填寫主要房客姓名以登記預訂。)

    Enter the main guest's full name.(請輸入主要房客的全名。)
    Check the email format, for example alex@example.com.(請檢查電子郵件格式，例如 alex@example.com。)

    Review your booking(確認預訂細節)

    Check everything, then confirm. Use Back to change anything.(請確認所有資料後再按確認；如需修改請按「返回」。)

    Total(總計)

    Booking confirmed!(預訂完成！)

    Thank you for choosing Dahu Park Hotel.(感謝您選擇大湖公園飯店。)
